mapper.select: SELECT h.*, CONVERT(h.house_images USING utf8) as house_images, a.agent_name as agent_name, a.agent_phone as agent_phone FROM h_house h LEFT JOIN sys_agent a ON h.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE h.house_status = 1 AND h.house_audit_status = 2 ORDER BY h.house_create_time DESC

SELECT h.*, CONVERT(h.house_images USING utf8) as house_images, a.agent_name as agent_name, a.agent_phone as agent_phone FROM h_house h LEFT JOIN sys_agent a ON h.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE h.house_id = #{id}
SELECT *, CONVERT(house_images USING utf8) as house_images FROM h_house WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY house_create_time DESC

SELECT h.*, CONVERT(h.house_images USING utf8) as house_images, a.agent_name as agent_name FROM h_house h LEFT JOIN sys_agent a ON h.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE h.house_audit_status IN (0, 1) ORDER BY h.house_create_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h_house WHERE house_audit_status IN (0, 1)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO h_house ( agent_id, house_title, house_address, house_province, house_city, house_district, house_community, house_area, house_price, house_unit_price, house_type, house_layout, house_floor, house_total_floor, house_building_year, house_orientation, house_decoration, house_property_type, house_property_fee, house_elevator, house_heating, house_description, house_images, house_video_url, house_facilities, house_tags, house_status, house_audit_status ) VALUES ( #{agentId}, #{title}, #{address}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{community}, #{area}, #{price}, #{unitPrice}, #{houseType}, #{layout}, #{floor}, #{totalFloor}, #{buildingYear}, #{orientation}, #{decoration}, #{propertyType}, #{propertyFee}, #{elevator}, #{heating}, #{description}, CAST(#{images} AS JSON), #{videoUrl}, CAST(#{facilities} AS JSON), #{tags}, #{houseStatus}, #{auditStatus} )
mapper.update: UPDATE h_house SET house_status = #{status} WHERE house_id = #{id}
UPDATE h_house SET house_audit_status = #{auditStatus}, house_reject_reason = #{rejectReason} WHERE house_id = #{id}
UPDATE h_house SET house_view_count = house_view_count + 1 WHERE house_id = #{id}
UPDATE h_house SET house_favorite_count = house_favorite_count + 1 WHERE house_id = #{id}
UPDATE h_house SET house_favorite_count = house_favorite_count - 1 WHERE house_id = #{id} AND house_favorite_count > 0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT house_city FROM h_house WHERE house_city IS NOT NULL AND house_city != '' ORDER BY house_city
SELECT DISTINCT house_district FROM h_house WHERE house_city = #{city} AND house_district IS NOT NULL AND house_district != '' ORDER BY house_district

SELECT h.house_province AS province, h.house_city AS city, h.house_district AS district, COUNT(*) AS houseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN h.house_status = 1 AND h.house_audit_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS publishedCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(h.house_price), 2), 0) AS averagePrice, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN h.house_unit_price IS NOT NULL AND h.house_unit_price > 0 THEN h.house_unit_price WHEN h.house_area IS NOT NULL AND h.house_area > 0 THEN (h.house_price * 10000 / h.house_area) ELSE NULL END ), 2), 0) AS averageUnitPrice FROM h_house h WHERE h.house_province IS NOT NULL AND h.house_province != '' AND h.house_district IS NOT NULL AND h.house_district != '' GROUP BY h.house_province, h.house_city, h.house_district ORDER BY houseCount DESC, publishedCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT h.house_province AS province, h.house_city AS city, h.house_district AS district, COUNT(*) AS houseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN h.house_status = 1 AND h.house_audit_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS publishedCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(h.house_price), 2), 0) AS averagePrice, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN h.house_unit_price IS NOT NULL AND h.house_unit_price > 0 THEN h.house_unit_price WHEN h.house_area IS NOT NULL AND h.house_area > 0 THEN (h.house_price * 10000 / h.house_area) ELSE NULL END ), 2), 0) AS averageUnitPrice FROM h_house h WHERE h.agent_id = #{agentId} AND h.house_province IS NOT NULL AND h.house_province != '' AND h.house_district IS NOT NULL AND h.house_district != '' GROUP BY h.house_province, h.house_city, h.house_district ORDER BY houseCount DESC, publishedCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
